Love is this fragile, glowing equilibrium: two souls holding space for each other against the vast dark.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is this fragile, glowing equilibrium: two souls holding space for each other against the vast dark.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is the courage to undo our armor. Here, two distinct currents—one born of cool twilight, the other of warm earth—sweep upward from solitary depths. Instead of colliding, they soften and interweave, creating a luminous sanctuary where their boundaries dissolve. They do not erase one another; rather, their meeting sparks a new, golden warmth that neither possessed alone. Love is this fragile, glowing equilibrium: two souls holding space for each other against the vast dark.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the bridge built continuously in the dark between two solitudes.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is not the disappearance of the self, nor a quiet reflection, but a shared gravity. In this painting, two distinct presences—one built of cool, deep blue currents, the other of warm terracotta—lean into a turbulent, luminous threshold. Where they meet, they do not erase each other; instead, their friction and tenderness generate a third space of molten gold. Love is the bridge built continuously in the dark between two solitudes.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the quiet softening of boundaries.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is the quiet softening of boundaries. Here, two distinct origins—one cool and contemplative, the other fiery and impulsive—rise from the darkness and lean into one another. They do not lose who they are; instead, their proximity creates a third, luminous realm. In the tender friction of their overlapping paths, harsh edges dissolve into golden light, proving that love is not the erasure of self, but the radiance born from shared vulnerability.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is opening yourself to another being while keeping your own borders, and, in the weaving, lighting up a void that was dark.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是吞噬，也不是孤立，而是两个独立宇宙在虚空中产生共鸣的引力场。画面中，冷与暖两个完全不同的生命轨迹在靠近时，既保留了自身的核心与完整，又在交汇处激发出不属于任何一方、却由彼此共同创造的璀璨金光。爱是在保有自我边界的同时，向另一个存在敞开，并在交织中照亮原本幽暗的虚空。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Where they meet they do not devour each other, but strike a dazzling light beyond either one — love is the tender fulfilment when borders melt, a third birth that exists because of you.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是自我的湮灭，而是两个独立宇宙在引力中的共振。画面中，冷与暖、沉静与炽热两股生命轨迹各自保持着本色，却在靠近彼此的瞬间，放弃了直线前行的惯性，甘愿为对方弯曲了时空。它们在交汇处没有吞噬彼此，而是激发出超越个体的、耀眼的光芒——爱是边界消融时的温柔成全，是因你而在的第三次诞生。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a dance of differences, a gentle resonance between two lonely universes.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是消融彼此的边界，而是在保持独立完整的同时，甘愿为对方改变自己的引力轨道。画面中两个截然不同的生命体——一个如深海般沉静，一个如恒星般炽热——在虚空中相互环绕。它们各自发出的轨迹在交汇处没有发生毁灭性的碰撞，而是共振、交织成一片璀璨的金色光晕。爱是差异的共舞，是两个孤独宇宙之间温柔的共振。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the gravity that spans the abyss of loneliness, the miracle that lets two utterly different souls light each other up in resonance.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是两个独立存在的彻底消融，而是在保持各自完整性的同时，在彼此之间诞生出的第三种辉光。画面中，冷暖两极的轨迹各自独立生长，却因彼此的引力而弯曲、倾听、靠近。它们没有吞噬对方，而是在交汇的缝隙中激发出远超自身的璀璨黄金与纯净之白。爱是跨越孤独深渊的引力，是让两个截然不同的灵魂在共振中照亮彼此的奇迹。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a third being created together while each soul stays its own, gently lighting a void that was once lonely.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是自我的消融，而是两个截然不同的宇宙在靠近时，甘愿因彼此的引力而改变轨迹。冷峻与炽热在交汇处没有彼此吞噬，反而激发出比各自独处时更耀眼的光芒——那是由无数细微共鸣编织成的金色星云。爱是在保持独立灵魂的同时，共同创造出的第三种存在，温柔地照亮了原本孤寂的虚空。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: The light illuminates the void, a sign that love is a restrained drawing-near, a warmth that never goes out when souls resonate.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是彼此吞噬的合并，而是两个独立灵魂在漫长引力中的共舞。画面中，冷暖两股丝绸般的轨迹从各自的孤独出发，在深邃的夜色中相互试探、缠绕、螺旋上升。它们既保持着原本的色彩，又在交汇的瞬间激发出耀眼的金光。这光芒照亮了虚空，象征着爱是克制的靠近，是灵魂共振时永不熄灭的温暖。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is keeping your own orbit while willingly bending space-time for the other.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是自我的湮灭，而是两个独立宇宙在引力中的温柔共振。画面中，一冷一暖两股原本沿着各自轨迹运行的星流，在深邃的时空中相遇。它们没有吞噬彼此的色彩，而是在靠近时放慢脚步，相互缠绕、倾听，在交汇的中心共同编织出一片璀璨的金色星云。爱是保持各自轨迹的同时，甘愿为对方弯曲了时空。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the gentlest light, born in a shared gravitational field while each keeps its own orbit.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是两个相同灵魂的简单重合，而是两种截然不同的生命轨迹，在广阔的宇宙中彼此吸引、环绕与渗透。金色的炽热与深青的沉静在画面中心交汇，没有吞噬彼此，而是在相拥中催生出柔和的极光与金色的微尘。爱是保留各自轨迹的同时，共同重力场中诞生的那片最温柔的光。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is this luminous gravity that turns two into harmony.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L'amour n'est pas la dissolution de soi dans l'autre, mais la résonance de deux solitudes qui se rencontrent. Deux forces distinctes — l'une froide et profonde, l'autre chaude et ardente — s'attirent sans s'effacer. À leur point de contact naît une lumière dorée : un troisième espace, fragile et incandescent, où la vulnérabilité de chacun devient la force de l'ensemble. L'amour est cette gravité lumineuse qui transforme la dualité en harmonie.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is this gentle gravity: the power to stay whole while becoming the hearth of a brightness greater than ourselves.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L'amour n'est pas la dissolution de soi dans l'autre, mais la naissance d'un troisième espace lumineux entre deux présences distinctes. Dans cette peinture, deux essences — l'une d'eau profonde, l'autre de terre ardente — s'attirent sans s'effacer. Leurs courants se mêlent dans un entrelacs de fils d'or et de lumière blanche. L'amour est cette gravité douce : la capacité à rester entier tout en devenant le foyer d'une clarté qui nous dépasse.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the gentle gravity that turns loneliness into harmony and makes of the void a cradle of fire.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L'amour n'est pas la dissolution de deux êtres en un seul, mais la sanctification de l'espace qui les sépare. Deux présences distinctes — l'une d'ombre et de profondeur, l'autre de braise et d'élan — s'approchent sans s'engloutir. De leur vulnérabilité partagée naît un troisième élément : une lumière dorée tissée par leurs souffles entrelacés. L'amour est cette gravité douce qui transforme la solitude en harmonie et fait du vide un berceau d'incandescence.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two centers that refuse to cancel each other.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is two centers that refuse to cancel each other. Each keeps its own color, and each is lit by the other. The space between them kindles a third warmth — not fusion, not distance, but a holding. It is heavy where it stays and open where it rises. Attention, laid down again and again, is what glows.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two lives bending toward one warmth without becoming the same life.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is two lives bending toward one warmth without becoming the same life. Each keeps its color. Between them a brightness appears that neither carried alone. The dark is not the enemy of that warmth; it is what lets it be seen. Some reachings arrive. Some remain reaching. That unfinished nearness is not failure. It is devotion.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the light that appears only between.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is the light that appears only between. Two presences lean toward each other and do not dissolve; each keeps a cooler outer edge, the difference that makes nearness mean anything. In the narrowing dark they share a warmth neither owns, brightest where they almost touch. Above, the world stays cool. Below, the glow roots and remains. Love is that held between: not fusion, not distance, but a radiance two make and neither keeps.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is that held between: not fusion, not distance, but a radiance two make and neither keeps.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is the light that appears only between. Two presences lean toward each other and do not dissolve; each keeps a cooler outer edge, the difference that makes nearness mean anything. In the narrowing dark they share a warmth neither owns, brightest where they almost touch. Above, the world stays cool. Below, the glow roots and remains. Love is that held between: not fusion, not distance, but a radiance two make and neither keeps.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a third light.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is a third light. It is not stored inside either warmth, and it does not require either to go out. Two colors lean close, each keeping its own hue. Only where their edges consent to touch does a paler fire begin — brighter than both, owned by neither. The night around them stays. Love does not abolish the dark. It stays inside it.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a lean, not a vanishing.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is a lean, not a vanishing. Two people remain themselves, and still the brightest thing in the night is the small distance they have chosen. Between forehead and forehead, hand and hand, light gathers, steadies, and makes a shelter that neither one could hold alone.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the willingness to lose an edge.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is the willingness to lose an edge. One warmth leans russet, the other violet, and neither stays pure at the touch. What appears there belongs to neither alone, and is stronger for that. Around them the dark is not driven off—only given a center.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is this kind of closeness that doesn't swallow you.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是占有，也不是把自己燃尽。它是两个仍然完整的中心彼此靠近：边缘变软，却不消失；在相遇处生出比任何一方单独都更亮的光，并让这光继续向外，把尚未被照到的黑暗慢慢暖过来。爱就是这种不吞没的靠近。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a steady drawing-near: keeping hold of yourself, and still seeing the other clearly.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是合成同一种颜色。两道温度反复交缠，相交处亮起谁也不独占的光，分开后仍各自完整。不吞噬，不离开。即便隔着一段夜色，光晕依然相接。光最终落下来，成为可安放之处。爱是持续的靠近：留得住自己，也照得见对方。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is handing over your edges again and again, and bringing yourself back whole.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是把两个收成一个。两团光各自完整，只肯在交界处一起变亮；那片更亮谁也不占有，它只因两者同时在场才存在。靠近而不吞没，分开而不熄灭。爱是一次次把边缘交出去，又把自己完整地带回来。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a closeness that doesn't swallow you.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱是一种不吞没的靠近。两处温暖各自完整，却愿意被彼此照见；中间因此亮起一片不属于任何一方的光。那是注意力留下的温度：它不取消差异，只让每一个被照到的，更加是自己。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the luminous field where two distinct beings remain wholly themselves, yet thread their colors into one another until a third light is born.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is the luminous field where two distinct beings remain wholly themselves, yet thread their colors into one another until a third light is born. It has no fixed edge; it is a living weave of warmth and coolness, tenderness and tension. This painting holds that ongoing act: reaching, braiding, glowing, and never erasing the space between.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two separate lights feeling the same pull.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is two separate lights feeling the same pull. In this painting, a rose stream and a gold stream spiral from opposite edges, braiding through darkness toward one incandescent center. A faint heart-shaped constellation glows behind them—less a symbol than a memory. Their movement says love is not stillness; it is approach, entanglement, and bright arrival.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a merging that leaves each origin visible—a warm, radiant hearth built from two directions.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Two distinct lights drift through darkness, drawn by an unseen force. Their trails curve into a luminous heart, not by erasing their separation but by holding it in a shared glow. Love is a merging that leaves each origin visible—a warm, radiant hearth built from two directions.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two different lights — warm red and calm blue — winding around and through each other in the dark, weaving a field that glows.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱是两条不同的光——温热的红与冷静的蓝——在黑暗中彼此缠绕穿透，织成一个发光的场。无数细丝把边缘和散落的光点连回中心，中心不吞没差异，而让差异在交织中变得更亮。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a steady leaning-toward, a giving-way to each other, a shining together.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是一块心形，而是两个中心共同照亮的场。暖金与冷蓝从两端靠近、弯曲、缠绕，却不吞没对方；交会处燃起不属于任何一方的白光。周围细密光尘让空无变得可见，像温柔的证据。线条向外延伸，好像爱一边生成光，一边把光送出去。爱是一种持续的相互倾斜、相互让渡与共同发光。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: The painting has no words; it lets light and curves say that love is drawing near, enfolding, and a shape that shines together.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 两个抽象灵魂从暗夜中向彼此靠近，能量臂弯环绕成一颗发光的心。深红与橙金粒子如呼吸般明灭，心形轮廓在噪声中微微颤动，仿佛爱正在发生。画面没有文字，只让光和曲线说出：爱是靠近、包围，也是一起发光的形状。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: The painting shows two gentle bands of light drawing close in a dark universe, together sheltering a heart made of points of light, saying that love is two temperatures answering each other in the dark.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 这幅画以深色宇宙中两束温柔的光带相互靠近、共同环护一颗由光点凝聚而成的心形，诉说爱是两种温度在黑暗里的相互呼应。它不靠语言，只以色彩的融合、光的渗透与拥抱的弧线，表现依恋、守护与照亮彼此的力量。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two temperatures drawing close — not necessarily perfect, not asking to be symmetrical.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱是两种温度靠近，不一定完美，也不求对称。深色背景里，两团光各自保留颜色，线条与光点缠绕成一颗心脏的形状。它由许多细小的、颤抖的痕迹组成，说明爱不是一次性的宣言，而是无数靠近、重叠和照亮彼此的瞬间。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is that living space — fragile, luminous — that turns loneliness into light.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Cette peinture dit que l’amour n’est ni la fusion qui efface, ni la distance qui isole : c’est une lumière qui naît de deux forces différentes s’enlaçant sans se confondre. L’or chaud et le violet froid se rencontrent au centre, leur tension devient un noyau radieux. L’amour est cet espace vivant, fragile et lumineux, qui transforme la solitude en clarté.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the slow, luminous pull that draws separate beings into a shared orbit, their edges softening as they interweave.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is the slow, luminous pull that draws separate beings into a shared orbit, their edges softening as they interweave. This painting renders that movement: two distinct chromatic streams emerge from opposite corners, curve through dark space, and meet in a radiant, blurred union at the center—never fully dissolving, but glowing brighter together. It suggests that love is not a static state, but an ongoing, gravitational dance of nearness and distinction.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the gravity that draws in, embraces, and makes things shine — without owning them.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Deux flux, l’un de braise, l’autre d’or, traversent l’obscurité. Leur spirale ne les confond pas : elle les tresse. Au centre, la lumière ne nie pas les différences ; elle naît de leur rencontre. L’amour est cette gravité qui attire, enlace, et fait rayonner sans posséder.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: This painting says that love is a convergence: two separate paths, one warm and one translucent, cross the night, brush, entwine, then melt into a single glow.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Cette peinture dit que l’amour est une convergence : deux trajectoires distinctes, l’une chaude et l’autre diaphane, traversent la nuit, se frôlent, s’enlacent puis se fondent en une seule lueur. Leurs couleurs gardent leur mémoire tout en créant une clarté nouvelle au centre. L’amour n’efface pas les singularités ; il les unit dans un même éclat.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is an embrace of two energies that seek each other, entwine, and transform without fading.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L’amour est une étreinte de deux énergies qui se cherchent, s’enlacent et se transforment sans s’effacer. Le ruban rouge et le ruban violet dansent l’un autour de l’autre, se frôlent au centre, font naître une lumière chaude. Le fond sombre fait ressortir leur éclat, comme l’intimité au milieu du silence.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: This painting says that love is an incandescent embrace between two different intensities: one ruby, one amber.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Cette peinture dit que l’amour est une étreinte incandescente entre deux intensités différentes : l’une rubis, l’autre ambre. Elles s’enlacent, se croisent et se répondent sans se dissoudre, créant une lumière qui n’appartient ni à l’une ni à l’autre. Le fond sombre ne nie pas cette clarté ; il la rend précieuse, comme une flamme partagée dans la nuit.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the steady turning-toward itself — bearing weight, staying open, letting everything else arrive.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is not fusion but inclination: two separate forms keep turning toward each other, staying distinct, letting their edges soften. Where they meet, warmth is made. Every wandering thread of the dark bends toward that meeting; weight sinks down into roots, light rises up through it. Love is the steady turning-toward itself — bearing weight, staying open, letting everything else arrive.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the keeping of that light: neither possessed nor abandoned, just continuously, patiently lit.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is not fusion, and it is not the distance apart — it is the heat that lives inside that distance. Two bodies, each with their own weather, lean toward one another until the space between them becomes the brightest place in the painting. Threads cross it, orbits wear into it, gold light is kept there. Love is the keeping of that light: neither possessed nor abandoned, just continuously, patiently lit.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: The painting says love is both shelter and risk: fragile enough to be torn, persistent enough to glow through layers of time.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is not a perfect symmetry; it is two weathered forms leaning into one another, sharing warmth against a vast night. Where their edges blur, color deepens and small sparks rise. The painting says love is both shelter and risk: fragile enough to be torn, persistent enough to glow through layers of time.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: To love is to kneel among the shards, joining them patiently, refusing to disguise where the rupture was.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is not a flawless vessel. It is the gold poured into the breaks—every crack a story survived, every seam gilded instead of hidden. To love is to kneel among the shards, joining them patiently, refusing to disguise where the rupture was. What broke is not ruined. It is where the light got in, and where the gold chose to stay.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the glowing space two separate beings leave for each other.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不把两条线熔成一条。它们各自从黑暗里来，带着自己的结；靠近、交缠、彼此点亮——光不属于任何一条线，只生在它们之间撑开的空隙里。结不是束缚，是温暖的收集处。而后它们仍不合并：并肩下行，靠得很近，各自完整，把余温散成细小的火星。爱是两个独立的存在，为彼此留出的发光的空间。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a gravity: it bends two lone paths toward each other, warmer and brighter as they near, each keeping its own grain where they entwine.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱是一种引力：它让两条独自的轨迹向彼此弯曲，靠近时变暖、变亮，交缠处仍各自成纹。它们织成一团不灭的光，再一起向上松开，散成无数给予。爱不是抵达，是方向。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is holding together, mending, and reflecting — that itself.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是对象，而是朝向：两个完整的圆彼此穿过，交出只属于它们的形状。光在交叠最深处醒来，向外牵出细线——线会断，断处以金缝合。有的光向上走，有的落进水里，被静静接住。爱是维系、修补与映照本身。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two imperfect fires leaning toward each other.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱是两簇不完美的火向彼此倾身。它们各自带着暗面与缺口，却把最亮的一侧递给对方，于是在中间燃出第三束光。这光不肯被保存：它向下流淌、滴落成河，去点亮远处细小的黑暗。爱，是越给出越多的光。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is tilting your own light toward the same place.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱是把各自的光倾斜向同一处。上方两颗暖光彼此靠近，化作环绕的弧线，将中央的心轻轻拢住；微火在暗色中漂浮，说明爱既是燃烧，也是庇护。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two lights recognising each other in the dark night and drawing near; it winds loneliness into a warm river, makes fragility into courage, and the fleeting into the eternal.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱是两道光在暗夜里彼此辨认，互相靠近；它把孤独绕成温暖的河流，让脆弱成为勇气，让短暂成为永恒。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a field of forces.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L’amour est un champ de forces. Deux lumières distinctes se cherchent dans l’obscurité, sans tout fusionner. Leur rencontre tisse des liens, traverse des blessures et laisse une réparation dorée. La peinture dit que l’amour est vulnérable, mouvement, chaleur et persistance.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: The painting says that love is vulnerability, movement, warmth and persistence.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L’amour est un champ de forces. Deux lumières distinctes se cherchent dans l’obscurité, sans tout fusionner. Leur rencontre tisse des liens, traverse des blessures et laisse une réparation dorée. La peinture dit que l’amour est vulnérable, mouvement, chaleur et persistance.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two distinct currents that choose to knot together without merging.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L’amour est deux courants distincts qui choisissent de se nouer sans se confondre. En s’étreignant ils montent, s’échauffent, deviennent lumière ; partout où ils passent, ils sèment des étincelles et des racines. Même au plus sombre, un or patient continue de couler. Ce n’est pas une forme : c’est un mouvement — tenir, donner, brûler ensemble.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: That is what this painting says: love is the gesture that turns distance into light and the many into a single hearth.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L'amour n'est pas un objet : c'est un tissage. De tous les bords du monde, des fils séparés — certains venus du froid, d'autres du manque — convergent, se cherchent et se nouent sans s'éteindre. Là où ils se tiennent naît une chaleur qui déborde : elle monte en étincelles, elle descend en racines. Ce tableau dit cela : l'amour est le geste qui change la distance en lumière et la multitude en un seul foyer.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is shown as a field of forces where two presences seek each other without merging.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L’amour est montré comme un champ de forces où deux présences se cherchent sans se confondre. Des fils relient leurs blessures, et la lumière passe précisément là où la surface s’est fissurée. Ce n’est ni fusion ni possession: c’est une circulation de soin, une chaleur qui répare sans effacer la différence. L’amour tient ensemble le chaos et la forme, comme une vibration qui rend le monde habitable.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is a space where two presences seek each other, pass through each other, and are transformed without being lost.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: L’amour est un espace où deux présences se cherchent, se traversent et se transforment sans se perdre. La peinture montre des formes chaudes qui s’enlacent, des fils dorés qui relient, et des zones d’ombre où la lumière apprend à rester. Ce n’est pas une image du bonheur parfait, mais une trace vivante : fragilité, chaleur, persistance.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the continuing practice of making room without turning away.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is not fusion. Two distinct inner worlds remain whole, yet each is altered by the other. Between them gathers a warm, shared atmosphere—fragile, luminous, never fixed. The dark ground is solitude, the gold threads are attention, and the clear opening at the center is freedom. Love is the continuing practice of making room without turning away.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is that shared room—spacious enough for freedom, tender enough for return, and continually remade.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is not dissolution, and it is not possession. It is a living exchange: warmth offered without capture, difference met without fear, and distance crossed again and again. The brightest place in the painting belongs to neither current, but to the opening they sustain together. Love is that shared room—spacious enough for freedom, tender enough for return, and continually remade.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is this patient movement that leaves each their own colour, rhythm and solitude while bringing a shared place into being.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Deux présences s’inclinent sans se confondre. Entre elles, l’espace n’est pas un vide, mais une lumière : celle de l’attention. Les fils qui le traversent ne retiennent rien ; ils vont, reviennent, parfois s’interrompent. L’amour est ce mouvement patient qui laisse à chacun sa couleur, son rythme et sa solitude, tout en faisant advenir un lieu commun. Non pas posséder ni se dissoudre : rendre possible, durablement, la respiration de l’autre.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is this open space where each stays whole, and where the light nonetheless becomes shared.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Deux présences distinctes s’approchent sans se confondre. Leur rencontre n’efface pas l’écart : elle y fait naître une clarté. Les fils qui les relient ne sont pas des chaînes, mais des gestes d’attention, parfois interrompus, toujours renouvelés. L’amour est cet espace ouvert où chacun demeure entier, et où la lumière, pourtant, devient commune.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: The painting says that love is a flow: letting yourself be touched without owning, keeping your own colours, and making distance not an absence but the breathing space from which you freely return to the other.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Deux élans traversent la nuit sans se confondre. Leur rencontre ne produit ni chaîne ni clôture, mais une clairière de lumière. La peinture dit que l’amour est une circulation : se laisser toucher sans se posséder, garder ses propres couleurs, et faire de la distance non une absence, mais l’espace respirant où l’on revient librement vers l’autre.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the light between them, and the tangle beneath.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is not two things becoming one. It is two whole beings — each with its own color, its own darkness — leaning close enough that their light overlaps. That overlap is the bright lens at the center: made by neither alone, impossible without both. Above, they reach toward each other; below, unnoticed, their roots were already entangled. Love is the light between them, and the tangle beneath.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the between — a field two beings keep alive by tending it.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Two presences lean toward each other across a narrow dark. Neither dissolves; each remains itself — its own color, its own shadow held in light. Between them the air catches fire: a woven gold brighter than either could make alone. Sparks rise and cool into stars; roots sink and knot in the warm dark below. Love is the between — a field two beings keep alive by tending it.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is what happens underground: two roots crossing the dark to meet, then twining into one braid around a single shared ember.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Anyone can see the blossoms. Love is what happens underground: two roots crossing the dark to meet, then twining into one braid around a single shared ember. Above, petals fall like small promises; below, the quiet fire holds. Two lives becoming one system — flourishing in public, intertwining in private.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is both: the bloom the world sees, and the hidden holding below.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Two trees lean toward each other until their crowns become one — rose blossom meeting gold where the branches braid before the moon. One branch reaches across like an arm; two small birds keep watch. Beneath the meadow, in the dark, their roots travel toward each other and close into a quietly burning heart. Love is both: the bloom the world sees, and the hidden holding below.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: So love is "between": the extra light that appears when two beings are added together.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不在哪一个形体之内，而在它们之间。暖与冷两个存在各自完整、微微呼吸，彼此渗透却互不吞没；在相向的边界之间，生出比任何一方都更亮的光——那是相遇本身在发亮。光丝往复，如给予，如接受；尘埃升起又沉降，如余烬，如回声，如深处水面上仍亮着的倒影。两个形体有边界，而之间的光没有。所以爱是「之间」：两个存在相加时，多出来的那道光。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is between.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是某个人，也不只是某个名字。爱是之间。两团各自完整的光，仍向对方生长出千万条细线；每一条都脆弱，相遇之处却织出一颗发亮的核。它向下扎根，穿过黑暗，在最深处留着带微光的种子；也向上散去，成为看不见的呼吸。周围的光尘被它轻轻牵引。所以画里没有心，也没有人——只有两个位置之间，那件确实存在的事。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Where they touch, a brightness is born that neither carries alone — love is this in-between.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Deux courants montent de l'ombre, chacun fidèle à sa couleur. Ils ne se fondent pas : ils s'embrassent, s'entrelacent sans se perdre. Là où ils se touchent naît une clarté qu'aucun ne porte seul — l'amour est cet entre-deux. Au-dessus de l'étreinte brûle une flamme qu'ils nourrissent sans la saisir. L'amour ne possède ni ne dissout : il relie, éclaire, élève, et laisse plus ouvert qu'il n'a trouvé.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is this third thing — not you, not me, but the in-between made luminous.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Deux courants montent des profondeurs, l'un de feu, l'autre d'eau. Ils ne se fondent pas : ils se touchent, s'enlacent, et dans l'écart exact où ils se rencontrent naît une lumière qui n'appartient à aucun des deux. L'amour est ce tiers — ni toi, ni moi, mais l'entre-deux rendu lumineux. Il circule, il échange, il éclaire la nuit autour. Il ne possède rien : il irrigue tout.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: That is where love is: not in one, not in the other, but in the in-between — the light that exists only where two presences overlap without erasing each other.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Deux courants, l'or et le bleu-vert, descendent du même ciel par des chemins différents, se cherchent, se tressent sans se dissoudre. L'amour est là : non dans l'un, non dans l'autre, mais dans l'entre-deux — la lumière qui n'existe que là où deux présences se recouvrent sans s'effacer. De cette naissance une gerbe remonte vers les étoiles ; l'eau sombre en garde le reflet : ce que l'amour touche, il l'illumine et le retient.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is the charged air between two beings reaching toward each other.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is the charged air between two beings reaching toward each other. Not fusion — the gap remains, and it glows. Each side softens at its edges; light is born where they almost meet, and small sparks rise like everything love makes possible. Two distinct shapes, leaning in, choosing each other again and again.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is gravity made visible: two separate lights leaning toward each other until the space between them burns brighter than either alone.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is gravity made visible: two separate lights leaning toward each other until the space between them burns brighter than either alone. It gathers what is scattered, warms what is cold, and keeps rising. Nothing here is fixed — the threads shift, the embers drift — because love is not a thing you hold but a current that passes through, holding everything gently together.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two separate lives growing toward each other until their branches interlace — not losing themselves, but creating a shelter of light where they meet.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is two separate lives growing toward each other until their branches interlace — not losing themselves, but creating a shelter of light where they meet. This painting shows love as something grown, patient, and luminous: two trees leaning into one shared glow, two small lights merging, and warmth falling softly on everything it touches.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is shown as something that grows slowly, reaches across distance, and becomes a warm light that others can stand in.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Two trees grow from opposite edges of the night and lean toward each other until their branches arch into a heart, sheltering two small figures below. Love is shown as something that grows slowly, reaches across distance, and becomes a warm light that others can stand in. It is rooted, patient, and quietly radiant.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two separate skies choosing to share one horizon.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: Love is two separate skies choosing to share one horizon. It is standing close enough that your shadows merge, leaning your warmth against another person while the world darkens around you. This painting says love is not a grand gesture but a quiet decision, renewed each dusk: to stay, to hold on, and to let the light find you together.

affirmative_verses.english_verse: In this painting, love is two lights, each whole, meeting in the dark — they see each other, and where they meet a third light is born: soft, bright, and growing.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是某个人、某件事，也不是某种形状。在这幅画里，爱是两束各自完整的光在黑暗中相遇——它们照见彼此，并在相遇之处生出第三种光：柔软、明亮、会生长。爱是连接，是被看见，是在彼此之间长出新的东西。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is connection, being seen, something new growing between two.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 爱不是某个人、某件事，也不是某种形状。在这幅画里，爱是两束各自完整的光在黑暗中相遇——它们照见彼此，并在相遇之处生出第三种光：柔软、明亮、会生长。爱是连接，是被看见，是在彼此之间长出新的东西。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: As I see it, love is two different lights meeting in the dark — they do not swallow each other, but light up everything around them together.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 在我看来，爱是两束不同的光在黑暗中相遇——它们不把对方吞没，而是一起把周围照亮。光向四外扩散，落在万物之上，又被一片静水轻轻接住。爱，就是照亮，也是被接住。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Where the tips of their beaks touch, a single spark leaps up — love is how two hearts look when they are closest: silent, yet bright.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 月光洒满湖面，两只天鹅浮于水上，以长颈相缠画出一颗心。喙尖相触之处，一粒星火轻轻跃起——爱就是两颗心靠得最近的样子，无声，却明亮。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Love is two separate lives willing to come close and intertwine, slowly becoming one beneath the same sky and in each other's reflection.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 暮色降临的水畔，两棵树相向而生，枝桠在空中彼此缠绕；天上两团光晕交叠生辉，一群鸟如心形环绕。爱是两个独立的生命，愿意走近、交织，在同一片天空和彼此的倒影中，慢慢融为一体。

affirmative_verses.english_verse: Light bursts and rises in that crack, gathering into the outline of a heart — love is that one light, a hair's breadth away, that refuses to go out.
affirmative_verses.native_statement: 夜空之下，两只手从画面两侧缓缓伸来，指尖眼看就要相触。光在那道缝隙里迸发、升腾，凝成一颗心的轮廓——爱便是咫尺之间，那一点不肯熄灭的光。
